semiconductor_relevance: High — Cermax Co., Ltd specializes in ceramic materials and components critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Cermax Co., Ltd is a key supplier of advanced ceramic materials and components for the semiconductor industry. They focus on machining and manufacturing ceramic parts, including Al2O3, AlN, Si3N4, SiC, and piezoelectric components, and offer specialized products like transparent alumina ceramics and CVD SiC wafers. Their advanced uniform heating systems and warpage control sensing systems cater to panel-level packaging applications.
capabilities: Machining and manufacturing of ceramic parts
CVD SiC wafers and semiconductor components
Advanced uniform heating systems for Panel-Level Packaging
